narr: Slow moving showers and thunderstorms produced locally heavy rainfall as a low pressure system moved east along a stationary boundary situated across the Ohio Valley.
ev: A stream was out of its banks and flowing across a roadway.
High water caused a partial road collapse near Bailey and Gano Roads.
State Route 41 was flooded with debris in the roadway near Enon.
Plum Run was completely out of its banks over state Route 56 with at least one foot of water rushing over the roadway.
Water was flowing over State Route 138 at Austin Road.
Spangler Road was closed due to water rushing over the roadway.
West Fork Road off of U.S. 22 was closed due to high water.
